title: Haitian independence
summary: Dessalines proclaims the independence of Haiti, the second independent state in the Americas.

title: Napoleon crowned emperor
summary: Napoleon crowns himself emperor in Notre-Dame, converting the revolutionary republic into a hereditary empire.

title: Battle of Austerlitz
summary: Napoleon defeats a Russo-Austrian army in his most famous set-piece victory.

title: British abolition of the slave trade
summary: Parliament bans the British Atlantic slave trade, then tries to police others at sea.

title: Grito de Dolores
summary: Miguel Hidalgo’s call to arms opens the mass phase of Mexican independence.

title: War of 1812
summary: The United States and Britain fight a messy war over impressment, trade, and the North American interior.

title: Battle of Leipzig
summary: A coalition smashes Napoleon’s army in the Battle of the Nations.

title: Congress of Vienna
summary: Allied diplomats rebuild a conservative European order after Napoleon.

title: Battle of Waterloo
summary: Wellington and Blücher defeat Napoleon, ending the Hundred Days.

title: Battle of Boyacá
summary: Bolívar’s victory at Boyacá secures the independence of New Granada.

title: First Opium War
summary: Britain forces Qing China open after a conflict rooted in opium, trade, and sovereignty.

title: Treaty of Waitangi
summary: The British Crown and many Māori chiefs sign a treaty whose two language versions still disagree.

title: Taiping Rebellion
summary: Hong Xiuquan’s millenarian movement fights the Qing in one of the deadliest wars in history.

title: Indian Rebellion of 1857
summary: Sepoy mutiny and civilian uprising shake Company rule; the Crown takes over India.

title: On the Origin of Species
summary: Darwin publishes a theory of evolution by natural selection that remade biology and cultural debate.

title: American Civil War
summary: Eleven slaveholding states secede; the Union fights to restore the United States and, increasingly, to destroy slavery.

title: Emancipation Proclamation
summary: Lincoln declares enslaved people in rebel-held territory free, tying the Union war to abolition.

title: Meiji Restoration
summary: Tokugawa rule ends; a new Meiji state begins a crash programme of reform and industrialization.

title: Suez Canal opened
summary: The canal joins the Mediterranean to the Red Sea and shortens Europe–Asia sea routes.

title: German Empire proclaimed
summary: William I is proclaimed German emperor at Versailles after the Franco-Prussian War.

title: Berlin Conference
summary: European powers set rules for claiming Africa, accelerating the Scramble.

title: First Sino-Japanese War
summary: Meiji Japan defeats Qing China and takes Taiwan, shocking the regional order.

title: Discovery of X-rays
summary: Wilhelm Röntgen detects X-rays, opening a new medical and physical technique.

title: Spanish–American War
summary: The United States defeats Spain and takes overseas colonies, including the Philippines and Puerto Rico.
